lead_raw_text:
The structure of ZnAg₂Te₃ crystallizes in the triclinic space group P1 (No. 119), with a unit cell containing six atoms and six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies tetrahedral environments throughout: Ag centers coordinate to four Te neighbors, Zn centers also to four Te neighbors, and Te centers coordinate to combinations of Ag and Zn, with neighbor distances ranging from about 2.53 to 2.66 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all six sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows corner-sharing between Ag tetrahedra, between Ag and Zn tetrahedra, and between Te tetrahedra.
